title: Applying Language Models in Clinical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives
abstract: arXiv:2609.34780v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. translated_title: 在临床医学中应用语言模型：近期趋势与展望
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）在医学研究和临床实践中的应用与适用性近年来在文献中受到越来越多的关注。大型语言模型（LLM）的出现扩展了关于AI在医疗保健领域应用的讨论。虽然传统基于深度学习的医学AI应用通常专注于特定且定义明确的任务，但LLM在处理现有数据方面提供了更广泛的能力和灵活性。与此同时，将LLM整合到医疗环境中也引发了关于其可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性以及在医疗环境中适当角色的重要问题。本文介绍并讨论了近期关于LLM在医学中应用的演讲和文章，特别强调了它们在研究和临床实践中的潜在效用，同时探讨了这些技术所带来的机遇（原文摘要在此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 本文综述了大型语言模型在医学研究与临床实践中的应用现状与趋势，探讨了其相比传统深度学习AI的更广泛能力，以及在可靠性、准确性和安全性方面面临的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews recent trends in applying large language models to medical research and clinical practice, highlighting their broader capabilities over traditional deep learning AI and the challenges regarding reliability, accuracy, and safety.
